title: Global Markets OHLCV — Intraday
subtitle: Consolidated 1m–1h OHLCV CSVs from Yahoo Finance (retention-pruned)
description:
## Overview

**Intraday OHLCV** bars (`1m` … `1h`) for the finance-dataset universe, pulled from [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/) via [`yfinance`](https://github.com/ranaroussi/yfinance).

**Daily / weekly** bars live in the sibling dataset: [benjaminpo/finance-dataset](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/benjaminpo/finance-dataset).

Updated several times on weekdays by [GitHub Actions](https://github.com/benjaminpo/finance-dataset).

Source repository: [benjaminpo/finance-dataset](https://github.com/benjaminpo/finance-dataset)

## Asset classes

Same prefixes as the daily dataset (`stocks_us/`, `crypto/`, `currencies/`, …).

## Layout & intervals

```
data/
├── stocks_us/
│   ├── 1m/AAPL.csv
│   └── 5m/AAPL.csv
└── …
```

- **Intraday** (`1m` … `1h`): one consolidated CSV per ticker (same path shape as daily). Yahoo only retains a short rolling window (`1m` ≈ 7 days; other intraday ≈ 60 days); each refresh merges new bars and prunes older ones.

## Schema

- Index: `Datetime` (UTC, ISO-8601)
- Columns: `Open`, `High`, `Low`, `Close`, `Adj Close`, `Volume` (plus `Dividends` / `Stock Splits` when present)
